tests.name: cbor_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that CBOR single-precision floats are correctly parsed and dumped.

tests.name: cbor_double_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that CBOR double-precision floats are correctly parsed and dumped.

tests.name: msgpack_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that MessagePack float format parses correctly.

tests.name: msgpack_double_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that MessagePack double format parses correctly.

tests.name: ubjson_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that UBJSON floating-point numbers parse correctly.

tests.name: bjdata_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that BJData single-precision numbers parse correctly.

tests.name: bon8_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that BON8 floating-point numbers parse correctly.

tests.name: cbor_nan_parsing
tests.intent: Verify parsing of NaN float values in CBOR.

tests.name: cbor_infinity_parsing
tests.intent: Verify parsing of infinity float values in CBOR.

tests.name: cbor_negative_zero
tests.intent: Verify parsing of negative zero in CBOR floats.

tests.name: cbor_roundtrip_float
tests.intent: Verify roundtrip serialization and deserialization of a float using CBOR.

tests.name: cbor_roundtrip_double
tests.intent: Verify roundtrip serialization and deserialization of a double using CBOR.

tests.name: stream_input_cbor_float
tests.intent: Verify parsing CBOR float values from an input stream adapter.

tests.name: stream_input_cbor_double
tests.intent: Verify parsing CBOR double values from an input stream adapter.

tests.name: sax_parse_cbor_float
tests.intent: Verify SAX parsing handles CBOR float fields cleanly via public interface.

tests.name: bson_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify BSON double-precision parsing behaves correctly.

tests.name: truncated_cbor_float
tests.intent: Verify truncation handling when reading CBOR floats.

tests.name: truncated_cbor_double
tests.intent: Verify truncation handling when reading CBOR doubles.

tests.name: ordered_json_cbor_float
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json also correctly handles float binary inputs.

tests.name: array_of_floats_cbor
tests.intent: Verify array containing multiple floats parses correctly via binary reader scalar run paths.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify that binary_reader::get() is invoked directly during sequential token processing on a byte stream, hitting the always-inlined get entry point.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Verify that static_assert for double size matches std::uint64_t during double byte swapping in big-endian CBOR parsing.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify that static_assert for float size matches std::uint32_t during float byte swapping in big-endian MessagePack parsing.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify that static_assert and float byte swapping are triggered correctly by UBJSON float type input format.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify that double byte_swap static_assert and implementation operate correctly when parsing BJData double-precision values.
